segments: A bird's eye view shows a neat studio apartment and a woman is lying on the couch, on her phone.
Her texts appear in green speech bubbles as she texts someone: "hey bestie! gonna start getting ready"
She swings her legs off the couch and texts: "see you soon!" She walks to her closet while stretching.
She opens her closet with an unsure look and texts: "what's the vibe tonight?" She slides a bunch of clothes over on the rack.
She smiles approvingly at her outfit in the mirror, but then frowns and texts: "are we doing cute?" She walks away.

A fast-paced montage of her considering many different styles and flipping through her closet, with texts accompanying each outfit: "casual? chic? preppy? sexy? punk? sporty? fancy? beachy? country? scene? vintage? boho? grunge? kawaii? rave?"
A text pops up that says "wait I got it!" and close-ups of her preparing this final outfit: picking a pair of pants, putting on footwear, and grabbing a purse.
Her outfit is unveiled with a tilt up from her shoes to her face, as she stands confidently and smiles. It's the same as the first outfit she chose. Glowing pink stars appear behind her.
With a smile, she opens her front door.
She receives a text, in a pink speech bubble, that says "sorry, fell asleep!!" Her face drops. The next text says "raincheck?" She looks up, disappointed.
Over shots of her now-messy apartment, she replies "sure! :)" and "couldn't find anything to wear anyway"
She's back to lying on her couch, looking at her phone, in the same position as the beginning. The screen cuts to black.
